name: GitHub
description: Reads repositories, issues, pull requests and Actions runs; with the write flag, comments, reviews and edits issues and pull requests (never pushes code).

servers.name: Built-in: GitHub Read
servers.title: GitHub (read)
servers.description: Reads repositories, issues, pull requests and Actions runs.

requirements.name: GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN
requirements.hint: Set GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN (a GitHub PAT, ghp_/github_pat_) in the container environment, then restart.

servers.name: Built-in: GitHub Write
servers.title: GitHub (write)
servers.description: Comments, reviews and edits issues and pull requests (never pushes code).

requirements.name: GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN
requirements.hint: Set GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN (a GitHub PAT, ghp_/github_pat_) in the container environment, then restart.

requirements.name: ODYSSEUS_GITHUB_MCP_WRITE
requirements.hint: Set ODYSSEUS_GITHUB_MCP_WRITE=1 as well as the GitHub token, then restart.

requirements.name: github-mcp-server binary
requirements.hint: Install github-mcp-server on PATH, or set ODYSSEUS_GITHUB_MCP_BINARY.
